Two coordinates for Attinghausen had reached this file, 46.8747/8.6247 and 46.8536/8.6156; the second is within roughly 500 metres of the village and is used here for both. Month unknown. The US$10 billion figure is an informed estimate from client interviews, never an audited disclosure.

stops.segment: Xapo: the Vault and the Complaint
stops.stop: San Jose, the cross-complaint and the letter
stops.date_confidence: Attested as allegation and pleading. Fortune of 28 July 2015 reports Casares's cross-claims for breach of contract, conversion and unjust enrichment, and a February 2014 letter from LifeLock president Hilary Schneider stating that LifeLock recognised his bitcoin work as unrelated to its business. A California court later stayed the action on an inconvenient-forum motion and related litigation went to Delaware; CoinDesk reports a further suit filed 22 September 2016. No consulted source discloses a merits verdict or a full public settlement. It is not the case that he was convicted of anything.

stops.stop: Gibraltar, the bank licensed
stops.date_confidence: Attested to Xapo Bank's own corporate history at xapobank.com and to the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission's bank register. The company dates the birth of the licensed bank to 2021 and gives no month, so the day defaults. The structural point, that fiat deposits fall under Gibraltar's statutory deposit protection while bitcoin custody is governed by segregation and custody law and not by deposit insurance, is drawn from the company's own compliance pages.
